items.title: Learning
items.summary: Learning through engineering questions, small experiments and reflection.

sections.heading: Learning Through Projects
body: I like to start with a real question, build a small baseline, test what works and explain the limits clearly.

sections.heading: Computational Civil Engineering
body: I’m exploring how computation and geospatial methods can help investigate civil-engineering problems.

sections.heading: Python and Geospatial Learning
body: My learning includes Python, spatial data and reproducible approaches to engineering analysis.

sections.heading: Decision-making
body: I’m interested in decision-making, incentives and judgement under uncertainty.

sections.heading: Cognitive Biases
body: I’m interested in how cognitive biases can shape judgement, decisions and communication.

sections.heading: Technical Communication
body: For technical communication, I try to explain the question, assumptions, evidence and limitations together.

sections.heading: Content as Learning
body: I use documenting and explaining real work as part of the learning process—not as a substitute for evidence.
